top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology is a mature, independently replicated arc from proglucagon processing and insulinotropic action through receptor biology to outcome-trial benefit in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease. P001 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) anchors the citation on the discovery of the physiology and the identification of the active form, treating the therapy as the evidence of consequence; the wording avoids ruling on priority against Habener. P002 (Knudsen in place of Mojsov) is a defensible development-centred alternative, since acylation-based half-life extension is a real scientific step, but it credits the product step rather than the discovery that opened the field, so I rank it second. No award is clearly worse than either given the maturity of the science.
